g.text: But greater forward excursion after revision

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Equal starting motion exposes a real tradeoff
Numerical scalar model. Curves: r = 100/s, w = 0.01 m/s². Bars: all six constant plant cases.
Gray = shared prefix. Dashed black = deadline. Squared jerk is a smoothness proxy, not physical energy.
FIR waits 0.10 s. Native matched uses minimum_duration = 0.90 s, not a minimum-jerk objective.
